source: BK5 printed pp.29-30 = book5-6.pdf PDF pp.35-36; errata.pdf PDF p.4 ER-36 deliberately not applied (O-C9 ruling 2026-10-13); Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative variant (derivation A, O-C9 ruling 2026-10-13): the uncorrected as-printed 5X/6E, ER-36 not applied, asserting the clean pushbutton-5 stop that the ER-36 fixture V-EXP16 cannot. Every expect is derived by hand from the 20-wire topology, not printed. Topology: 6H, 6Y and 5Y sit on +; pushbutton 6 puts + on 6X/6G/6F/D17/D16; relay 6 pulls in through 6F-coil-6E-indicator lamp-6C(-) and latches through 6H-6G; D17 runs the motor through R1 to D19, D18 on M-; the wiper D16 carries + to lamp 5 on D3/D5/D8/D9/D11 (dash) and lamp 6 on D4/D6/D10 (dot), so one turn spells C (D3-D6), a space at D7, then Q (D8-D11). The stop: pushbutton 5 puts + on 6E, so with relay 6 latched both coil ends sit on + and it drops; no path joins + to -, so the breaker never trips (with 5X/6C and 6C/6- it would). The O-C9 'shorts out the coil' reading is incomplete: once relay 6 is out, + on 6E feeds the coil to 6F and on through D17-R1-motor branch (about 32 ohms) and the wiper's lamp to -, about 70 mA against relay 6's 45 mA pull-in, so relay 6 buzzes while pushbutton 5 is held. The stop is settled at the release: with 6E off +, the only re-latch drive is 6F-coil-6E-indicator lamp, which must reverse the coil current through zero below drop-out, and the N.O. contact breaks about 3.6 ms into the release stroke, long before the reversed current could climb back to pull-in (about 42 mA asymptote through the lamp heated by 13 V during the hold). That race is a profile-timing claim [unverified]. No expect is placed while pushbutton 5 is held, and the dial rest position after the stop coast is not predicted; the stopped motor is shown by hand-setting the dial to 3 and finding it still on 3, dark, a second after letting go. Script choices, not printed: holding the knob on D3, D4 and D7 to read the CQ pad map, the 100 ms presses, and the final restart with pushbutton 6.
